name: blender-auto-3d-explode
description: Blender 自动拆解三维模型并自动做拆解教学 - 预览。基于 Three.js 构建的交互式 3D 拆解教学工具，支持鼠标拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、滑块控制拆解程度。

scripts.test: node tests/unit-test.mjs && node tests/provider-test.mjs && node tests/image-to-3d-router-test.mjs && node tests/ar-preview-test.mjs && node tests/export-panel-test.mjs && node tests/upload-panel-test.mjs && node tests/explode-controller-test.mjs && node tests/assembly-analysis-test.mjs && node tests/model-disposal-test.mjs && node tests/model-fit-test.mjs && node tests/custom-model-loader-test.mjs && node tests/custom-model-finalize-test.mjs && node tests/custom-model-panel-test.mjs && node tests/geometry-split-test.mjs && node tests/quest3-model-test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npx eslint main.js server.js src/ tests/ --fix
scripts.lint:check: npx eslint main.js server.js src/ tests/
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:all:check: npm run lint:check && npm run lint:css:check
scripts.format:all: npm run format && npm run lint:css
